reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 FunOldGames 与 Halfbrick Studios，发行商 Halfbrick Studios）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 273），首页有 1 个与 AI 直接相关的主题（“Will AI assets be in the final release of the game?”），已逐帖读取原文：主帖与跟帖都是玩家表示会因 AI 而不购买、并就开发者是否该用 AI 争论，属玩家立场表达与二手说法，按规则只登记不判定，不改变任何领域结论。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 0 篇原始来源：唯一可能是报道的一条转载页（Yahoo Tech 上的本作评测）中转返回的 HTML 只有标题、结构化元数据与站点脚本，正文为异步加载且描述文本只谈生涯模式与作弊机制，没有出现 AI 披露内容，按未读取登记；其余结果为本作商店页、讨论区主题页（已在讨论环节读取）、Facebook 与 Instagram 的宣传视频页。检索范围仅限工具实际返回的内容，不能据此认定没有其他公开报道。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计；披露未给任何数量或比例，正式版的处理方式亦未说明。本作处于抢先体验阶段。

english.summary: A pixel-art boxing simulation published by Halfbrick Studios and in Early Access since Oct 21, 2026. The store disclosure is a single line of two fragments, some voices and prompted cutscene backgrounds, naming those two areas and nothing else.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developers FunOldGames and Halfbrick Studios, publisher Halfbrick Studios) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 273), where one topic directly concerns AI use; it was opened and read in full. The opening post and the replies are players saying they will not buy the game while AI assets remain and arguing over whether developers should use AI at all, so they are logged as opinions without changing any area finding. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 0 raw sources were read: the one article-like result, a syndicated review on Yahoo Tech, returned only a title, structured metadata and site scripts through the relay because the body loads asynchronously, and its description covers the career mode and cheating mechanics rather than AI, so it is recorded as not read; the remaining results were the store page, the discussion thread already read in the discussion stage and promotional video pages on Facebook and Instagram. That describes the search range and is not proof that no other coverage exists. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit, and the disclosure gives no quantity or proportion. The title is in Early Access.
